name: Jev
description: Jev, TypeSafe's cheap typed classifier, as the "jev" plugin service: choice, yes/no and score questions for other plugins, with a usage log and a monthly cap.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Where requests go. Cost, balance and the dollar cap work only with OpenRouter. A custom base URL gets /v1/systemone appended.

customBaseUrl.title: Custom base URL
customBaseUrl.description: Only used when Endpoint is Custom, e.g. a LiteLLM proxy. https, or http for localhost only.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: The OpenRouter key, or the TypeSafe key for TypeSafe direct. Sent as a bearer token to the endpoint above only.

model.title: Model
model.description: Pinned so question thresholds stay valid. OpenRouter id: typesafe/jev-1.14. TypeSafe direct may want its own id (e.g. jev-latest).

monthlyCapUsd.title: Monthly spending cap ($)
monthlyCapUsd.description: Requests are refused once this month's cost (UTC month, all projects) reaches it. 0 turns it off. OpenRouter only: other endpoints report no cost.

monthlyRequestCap.title: Monthly request cap
monthlyRequestCap.description: Refuse requests past this many in a month, any endpoint. 0 turns it off. The cap to use where cost is unknown.

monthlyTokenCap.title: Monthly token cap
monthlyTokenCap.description: Refuse requests once this month's input tokens reach it, any endpoint. 0 turns it off.

timeoutSeconds.title: Request timeout (s)
timeoutSeconds.description: Budget for one request, retries and backoff included.

cli.name: jev
cli.summary: Jev usage, OpenRouter balance, or one request from stdin
cli.usage: jev [usage | balance | ask [--label L] < request.json | help]
